label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is FP because the sink at L62-L63 uses ESAPI encoder().encodeForHTML() which sanitizes the output before writing to the response, mitigating XSS. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection) is TP because the sink at L52 passes the 'sql' string directly to JDBCtemplate.queryForMap() without sanitization; 'sql' is constructed from 'bar' which derives from user input ('param') via a harmless Base64 round-trip, enabling SQL injection.

evidence.note: Direct usage of user-derived 'sql' variable in DatabaseHelper.JDBCtemplate.queryForMap(), confirming SQL injection vulnerability.
